Everything you need to know

We are based in Benin, more precisely in Cotonou, Akpakpa PK 5, Dandji Lot N°772, and registered under RCCM N°RB/PNO/18 B 2200 — IFU 3200801032318.

We work mainly on CIF (destination port) and sometimes FOB, where possible and depending on the client's needs.

Thanks to our network of partner cooperatives in Benin, the UEMOA and ECOWAS, and our investments in local processing, we handle everything from sampling lots (air freight) to monthly multi-container FCL contracts (sea freight). Our capacities adapt to harvest calendars to guarantee maximum availability.
